buccal.heroSubtitle: Facial Contouring for a Slimmer, More Defined Look
buccal.heroDesc1: Some faces retain a rounded or "baby-face" fullness despite a healthy weight and lifestyle. This fullness often comes from enlarged buccal fat pads, natural fat pockets located deep in the lower cheeks.
buccal.heroDesc2: Buccal fat removal is a surgical facial contouring procedure designed to selectively reduce this fat, creating sharper cheek definition and a more sculpted lower face.
buccal.whatIsDesc1: Buccal fat removal is a surgical procedure that reduces the size of the buccal fat pads located in the mid-to-lower cheeks. Clinical literature indexed on PubMed highlights the importance of conservative fat removal to avoid excessive hollowing as the face naturally ages.
buccal.whatIsDesc2: Buccal fat removal is not a weight-loss procedure and does not affect overall body fat. The goal is refinement, not drastic alteration.
buccal.keyPoint0: Slim a round or bulky lower face
buccal.keyPoint3: Create a more mature, sculpted appearance
buccal.howItWorksDesc: The procedure is precise and minimally invasive. The surgery is usually performed under local anaesthesia with sedation or general anaesthesia, depending on patient preference.
buccal.step0: Small incision made inside the mouth
buccal.step1: Gentle exposure of the buccal fat pad
buccal.step3: Internal suturing with no external scars
buccal.recoveryDesc: Recovery is generally straightforward. Postoperative recovery principles align with international surgical safety and infection-control standards outlined by the World Health Organization.
buccal.benefitsDesc: The goal is refinement, not drastic alteration.
buccal.benefit4: Can enhance jawline and cheek definition
buccal.candidateDesc: Proper patient selection is critical for natural outcomes. Ideal candidates typically:
buccal.candidate0: Have naturally full or rounded cheeks
buccal.notRecommendedDesc: Buccal fat removal may not be suitable for everyone:
buccal.notRecommended1: Older patients with significant facial volume loss
buccal.notRecommendedNote: When done conservatively, buccal fat removal complements natural facial structure without creating a hollow appearance.
buccal.comparisonTitle: Buccal Fat Removal vs Facial Fat Loss from Ageing
buccal.comparisonDesc: When done conservatively, buccal fat removal complements natural facial structure.
buccal.pricingDesc: Buccal fat removal cost varies depending on:
buccal.pricing0: Amount of fat to be removed
buccal.faqDesc: Get answers to common concerns about buccal fat removal
buccal.faq0A: It is a surgical procedure that reduces cheek fat to create a slimmer, more defined face.
buccal.faq1Q: Will my face look hollow after surgery?
buccal.faq1A: No, when performed conservatively by an experienced surgeon.
buccal.faq2A: Yes, the removed fat does not return.
buccal.faq3Q: How long is recovery after buccal fat removal?
buccal.faq3A: Most patients resume normal activities within a week.
buccal.faq4A: No, incisions are made inside the mouth so there are no external scars.
buccal.faq5Q: Can buccal fat removal be combined with other procedures?
buccal.faq5A: Yes, it can be combined with chin liposuction or other facial contouring procedures.
buccal.faq6Q: Is buccal fat removal safe in Malaysia?
buccal.faq6A: Yes, when performed by a certified plastic surgeon in a licensed facility.
buccal.faq7Q: Who should avoid buccal fat removal?
buccal.faq7A: Patients with very thin faces or significant facial volume loss from ageing are not ideal candidates.
buccal.ctaDesc1: Achieve a slimmer, more defined facial contour with surgeon-performed buccal fat removal in Malaysia.
buccal.ctaDesc2: When performed conservatively by a certified plastic surgeon, buccal fat removal enhances your natural facial structure for lasting, balanced results.
